p: Shenzhen Chenzhou Electrical Appliance CO., LTD. was founded on February 26, 2004, and is located in Building 15A of the Changzhan Changxing Technology Industrial Park in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province. The company mainly produces and sells DC brushless pumps; industrial permanent magnet brushless motors and control systems; high-speed brushless motors and control systems for RC aircraft; dual-frequency ultrasonic toothbrushes; ultrasonic household products; special micro pumps, and more. Through close cooperation with leading well-known companies in the field, we have accumulated extensive experience in applying our products across industries over nearly 20 years of specialized service. We provide not only high-quality products but also a complete set of technical and solution support, covering product design, complete machine production, and product use. Our professional, honest, and proactive sales team can grasp your requirements as quickly as possible and provide professional, efficient communication and support. Our experienced, precise, and reliable design team fully understands the application characteristics of different working environments and will customize the solution and product best suited to your application. We offer reliable and creative products, and we aim to be a long-term, dependable partner, sharing the joy of growing together.
pc: 深圳市辰舟电器有限公司成立于2004年2月26号，公司位于广东省深圳市长圳长兴科技工业园15A栋。主要生产经营直流无刷水泵；工业用永磁无刷电机及控制系统；航模用高速无刷电机及控制系统；双频超声波牙刷；超声波家用系列产品；特种微型系列水泵等。通过与该领域内领先的知名企业的紧密合作，在近20年的专业服务过程中，我们积累了丰富的行业和产品的应用经验。我们不仅能提供优质产品，更能为客户提供从产品设计、整机生产、产品使用、等一整套的技术和方案的支持。我们专业、诚信、积极的销售团队能最快的速度理解您的需求为您提供专业和高效的交流和支持。我们经验丰富、精准、可靠的设计团队可以充分的理解不同作业环境的应用特性，为您定制最适合您的应用场合的方案和产品。我们不仅提供可靠和富有创意的产品，更能成为您长久和踏实的合作伙伴，分享共同成长的快乐。
